purpose: Hierarchical tagging system with contexts, multi-language aliases, and flexible metadata for organizing content.

patterns.name: Hierarchical tags
patterns.description: Create nested tag structures with parent-child relationships.

patterns.name: Multi-language aliases
patterns.description: Provide localized tag names for internationalization.

pitfalls: Tags are scoped by 'context' - same tag name can exist in different contexts
Use the TagAlias class for multi-language support, not the main Tag class
